The following events took place in '''737 BBY'''.

==Events==
*The [[Grissmath Dynasty]] creates a penal colony on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. The Dynasty then attempts to seed the world with [[Droch/Legends|drochs]] in order to kill the prisoners. The attempt fails. {{C|Approximate date}}<ref name="POT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>
